item.text:
Bottom line: mixed. The strongest 2024 outcome signals moved in Scholz’s preferred direction on inflation, household purchasing power, and labor-market stability, but GDP still contracted, coalition breakdown undercut delivery, and some of the security/state-capacity outcomes were clearly negative. A fair reading is “partially yes, but uneven and constrained.”

### Evidence For
- [German economy slowly regaining its footing](https://www.bundesbank.de/en/press/press-releases/bundesbank-forecast-for-germany-german-economy-slowly-regaining-its-footing-933658) | Deutsche Bundesbank | 7 Jun 2024 | The Bundesbank said wage growth, falling inflation, and a stable labor market were helping households and that the economy was gradually recovering, which is directionally consistent with Scholz’s stability-and-relief aims after the 2022-23 shock. | 8B.7
- [Inflation at 2.2% in 2024](https://www.destatis.de/EN/Press/2025/01/PE25_020_611.html) | German Federal Statistical Office (Destatis) | 16 Jan 2025 | Inflation averaged 2.2% in 2024, far below the prior shock years; that is a real outcome improvement even if it was partly inherited disinflation and not uniquely attributable to Scholz. | 8B.7
- [Household recovery baseline from Bundesbank](https://www.bundesbank.de/en/press/press-releases/bundesbank-forecast-for-germany-german-economy-slowly-regaining-its-footing-933658) | Deutsche Bundesbank | 7 Jun 2024 | The Bundesbank explicitly linked improving household conditions to wage gains and lower inflation, which tracks with Scholz’s social-protection and purchasing-power agenda. | 8B.7
- [Housing budget 2024](https://www.bundestag.de/presse/hib/kurzmeldungen-987074) | Deutscher Bundestag | 19 Jan 2024 | Wohngeld remained the largest housing line item and low-price housing support was expanded, indicating real fiscal effort in the direction of shelter affordability, even if implementation effects would lag. | 8B.7
- [Budget 2025 and growth initiative](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/budget-2025-2298116) | Federal Government | 5 Jul 2024 | The 49-measure package emphasized tax relief, social housing, infrastructure, renewables, and growth, showing that the policy program translated into an actual budget framework rather than remaining rhetorical. | 8B.7; also 8B.6
- [Annual budget statement](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/service/newsletter-und-abos/bulletin/bundeskanzler-haushalt-2257440) | Bundesregierung | 31 Jan 2024 | Scholz tied the budget to lower social contributions, higher housing benefit, higher child benefit, and the child supplement, which is consistent with improving household life chances rather than merely announcing them. | 8B.7
- [Start-up and capital-markets reforms](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/german-cabinet-approves-measures-for-better-access-to-capital-markets-3744243) | Reuters | 27 Nov 2024 | The cabinet approved reforms to improve venture-capital taxation, remove obstacles to infrastructure and renewable investment, and cut bureaucracy, which is a concrete pro-growth output rather than a slogan. | 8B.7
- [OZG / digital service modernization](https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2024/kw08-de-onlinezugangsgesetz-990686) | Deutscher Bundestag | 23 Feb 2024 | The revised Online Access Act strengthened Bund-Länder structures and user-facing digital service delivery, indicating some administrative outcome in the direction of state-capacity improvement. | 8B.7
- [AI Act compromise](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/germany-will-approve-eus-planned-ai-act--sources-3286730) | Reuters | 30 Jan 2024 | Reuters reported that the government resolved its internal dispute and moved to approve the EU AI Act, which suggests at least one contested policy goal was converted into an operational compromise. | 8B.7
- [Bundeswehr mission review](https://www.auswaertiges-amt.de/en/newsroom/news/2664958-2664958) | Federal Foreign Office / Federal Ministry of Defence | 26 Jun 2024 | The government’s first overarching evaluation of missions used uniform criteria and identified concrete improvements, showing measured administrative learning rather than inert rhetoric. | 8B.7; also 8B.6

### Evidence Against
- [GDP fell 0.2% in 2024](https://www.destatis.de/EN/Press/2025/01/PE25_019_811.html) | German Federal Statistical Office (Destatis) | 15 Jan 2025 | Germany’s economy contracted in 2024, so the broad macro outcome did not match a strong prosperity or growth turnaround claim. | 8B.7
- [Coalition collapse](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/explainergerman-coalition-collapses-what-comes-next-3706936) | Reuters | 6 Nov 2024 | Scholz’s dismissal of Lindner collapsed the coalition and triggered political chaos, which undercut continuity and made it harder for any claimed program to show durable results. | 8B.7; also 8B.5
- [No-confidence vote](https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2024/kw47-vertrauensfrage-1030198) | Deutscher Bundestag | 16 Dec 2024 | Parliament withdrew confidence by a wide margin, confirming that Scholz ended 2024 without the governing majority needed to deliver on his agenda. | 8B.7; also 8B.5
- [Parliament on 49 measures](https://www.bundestag.de/presse/hib/kurzmeldungen-1034192) | Deutscher Bundestag | 17 Dec 2024 | The Bundestag was still asking how many of the 49 measures were actually implemented and what growth effect to expect, which is evidence that claimed outputs were not yet clearly visible. | 8B.7; also 8B.6
- [Security incident: Taurus leak](https://apnews.com/article/russia-germany-ukraine-taurus-missiles-recording-de408772f1edf3bd2f98fd5a3f64da3c) | AP | 4 Mar 2024 | The intercepted-call leak was a real command-and-control failure that raised misperception risk, so at least one state-capacity outcome moved in the wrong direction. | 8B.7; also 8B.5
- [BND surveillance ruling](https://www.bundesverfassungsgericht.de/SharedDocs/Pressemitteilungen/EN/2024/bvg24-093.html) | Bundesverfassungsgericht | 8 Nov 2024 | The Court found parts of the BND framework unconstitutional and oversight inadequate, which is a negative institutional outcome for clean state control and accountability. | 8B.7; also 8B.5
- [5G decision handled confidentially](https://www.onvista.de/news/2024/05-23-bericht-regierung-vertagt-entscheidung-ueber-strengere-vorschriften-im-5g-netz-0-20-26275293) | Reuters via onvista | 23 May 2024 | Sensitive 5G-security decisions were handled in confidential interministerial talks with no real-time public comment, which weakens confidence that the process translated cleanly into visible, auditable results. | 8B.7; also 8B.6
- [Warburg/Cum-Ex scrutiny report](https://www.tagesspiegel.de/politik/geheimes-kanzleramts-gutachten-in-cum-ex-affare-scholz-darf-weiter-in-deckung-bleiben-11756357.html) | Tagesspiegel | 4 Jun 2024 | The report suggested the Chancellery used a legal memo to blunt scrutiny, which is counterevidence to a clean, outcome-oriented governance style. | 8B.7; also 8B.6
- [Coalition uncertainty after Lindner dismissal](https://theprint.in/world/germanys-scholz-sacks-his-finance-minister-leaving-govts-future-unclear/2345270/) | Reuters | 7 Nov 2024 | Reuters described the government as entering minority-rule uncertainty, which is a direct drag on follow-through and makes outcome attribution weaker. | 8B.7; also 8B.5
- [AI and 5G timetables were precautionary, not final outcomes](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/service/newsletter-und-abos/bulletin/rede-von-bundeskanzler-olaf-scholz-2307122) | Bundesregierung | 5 Sep 2024 | Scholz set fixed timetables for AI and 5G security, but the existence of timetables is not the same as realized outcome improvement by year-end. | 8B.7; also 8B.6

### Search Gap
- The clearest outcome data are macroeconomic: inflation improved, wages and labor-market conditions were better, but GDP still fell.
- I found much less direct evidence on whether Scholz’s domestic reform goals produced measurable 2024 changes in productivity, housing stock, municipal capacity, or digital-service usage.
- Foreign-policy outcomes are harder to score cleanly: Scholz achieved continued support for Ukraine and avoided direct German escalation, but the war itself continued, so success depends on which revealed goal you treat as primary.
- Some positive policy moves were clearly process outputs in 2024, but their real-world effects likely require longer lags than the 2024 window allows.
